findings.title: Auto-save interval keeps saving the first draft
findings.explanation: The effect has an empty dependency array (lint rule suppressed on the line above) but the interval callback reads `draft`. It captures the initial empty string, so every save writes stale text.
findings.suggested_fix: Include `draft` and `save` in the dependency array, or keep the latest draft in a ref that the interval reads.

findings.title: Resize listener is never removed
findings.explanation: The effect registers a window listener and returns no cleanup, so the listener (and its state setter) outlives the component and stacks up on every remount.
findings.suggested_fix: Return `() => window.removeEventListener("resize", onResize)` from the effect.

findings.title: useState is called after an early return
findings.explanation: When `user` changes from null to an object the hook count changes between renders, which makes React throw. The rules-of-hooks lint rule is suppressed on the line above.
findings.suggested_fix: Call `useState` before the early return and keep the `if (!user) return null;` after all hooks.

limitations: Expected result for the evaluation harness; labelled by the maintainers.
